title: Pure relative dimension is preserved by base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Fix an integer $d\ge0$. If every nonempty fibre of $f$ is pure of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension], then for every morphism $S\prime\to S$, the base-changed morphism $f\prime:X\times_S S\prime\to S\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product] has every nonempty fibre pure of dimension $d$.

mathlib_searches.query: A base change of a locally finite type morphism with all nonempty fibres pure dimension d still has all nonempty fibres pure dimension d
pure relative dimension is preserved by arbitrary base change
mathlib_searches.results: isSmoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange and related smooth results, but no general pure-fibre-dimension result
Etale/Smooth relative-dimension declarations only; no general fibre-purity base-change theorem
